desc:
<◆><◇><◆><◇><◆><◇><◆><◇><◆><◇><◆><◇>

⚔️ Fight players, steal their time and enjoy an intense battle with classic sword fighting mechanics. Collect rare items around the map and find your way to the top!

💡 HOW IT WORKS 💡

• Leave the safe zone to start gaining time
• Defeat other players to steal their time
• Spend time to open cases and unlock swords
• Stronger swords = faster time farming

🎮 FEATURES 🎮

🗡️ | PvP Sword Combat
⏰ | Time-Stealing Gameplay
📦 | Case Opening System
💎 | Rare & Tradeable Swords
🏆 | Leaderboards & Progression
🥶 | Chill, fight, or troll — your choice
